title: Long Term Performance of Leveraged ETFs
one_line: Leveraged and inverse ETFs track their daily multiple over a day but drift away from it over horizons beyond about a quarter because of compounding (volatility decay).

findings.statement: 2x/−2x ETFs fairly track over ~1 month; deviations grow over longer horizons, worse in volatile markets.

reported_results.headline: Leveraged and inverse ETFs track their daily multiple over a day but drift away from it over horizons beyond about a quarter because of compounding (volatility decay).
